semanticReview.method: Seguimiento R33, lectura del artículo vigente y cotejo parcial de fuentes primarias gratuitas con localizadores exactos; se conserva el historial y no se extrapola la evidencia parcial.
findings: La ficha presenta 분 con numerales sino-coreanos y contrasta con 시, que suele usar números nativos.

NIKL guide pp. 53–54 supports Sino-Korean minute numerals with 분 in clock-time instruction. This only supports the core pattern; all example forms and generalizations need separate locators. APA 7/localizador cotejado: National Institute of Korean Language. (n.d.). 초급 한국어 쓰기 교원용 지침서 개발 보고서 [Teacher guide]. https://www.korean.go.kr/common/download.do?book_seq=294&c_file_name=48c417c6-047f-48f4-88a7-959f28e5e0ad_0.pdf&downGubun=bookDataView&file_path=bookData&o_file_name=%ED%95%9C%EA%B5%AD%EC%96%B4%EC%A7%84%ED%9D%A5-02-17.pdf Localizador: pp. 53–54: expressions of clock time; native Korean numerals with 시 and Sino-Korean numerals with 분. Supports this core contrast only; not every claimed form or all example translations.
limitations: No se consultó material oficial sobre contadores temporales, combinaciones hora/minuto o excepciones; los ejemplos necesitan fuente primaria.
The guide passage does not establish every numeral example or usage outside clock time. No canonical Evidence was created and assessEntry was not run.
